## Starter analytics dashboard

Created [Analytics basics (wizard)](https://us.posthog.com/project/723386/dashboard/2327243) with five starter views: workout completion, workout activity, programme activation, crew engagement, and workout-session shares. The views use the instrumented product-event contract and will populate once the app sends events.
